title: Your tenant portal at a glance

cues.text: What you owe and when, receipts, documents, notices and maintenance requests, in one place.
Welcome to your portal at The Wave. The home page shows what matters today.
Your balance: what is due and whether anything is overdue.
Your next invoice and its due date. Open it to see the details and pay online.
The menu has everything: invoices, sales reports, cheques, receipts, maintenance, documents and notices.
Invoices are grouped into to pay, upcoming and paid.
Something needs fixing in your store? Open a maintenance request and follow it until it is done.
Notices from the mall arrive here and by email: trading hours, drills, events.
The portal works in English and Arabic. And Help has these lessons any time.
